# FandomVerse

> The comprehensive fandom universe portal connecting fans of Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga worldwide.

FandomVerse is an immersive interactive web application dedicated to multi-fandom culture. It aggregates curated articles, character dossiers, blockbuster video trailers, official merchandise collections, and fan community events.

## Main Sections

- [Trailers & Teasers](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/trailers): Watch official trailers and teaser PVs across Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, and Comics with responsive pagination and category filtering.
- [Merchandise Shop](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/merchandise): Officially licensed scale figures, fandom apparel, chibi plushies, gaming gear, and limited collectibles.
- [Anime Universe](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/category/anime): Shounen news, seasonal anime rankings, and character dossiers.
- [Gaming Universe](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/category/gaming): AAA game launches, eSports highlights, and walkthroughs.
- [Movies Universe](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/category/movies): Hollywood blockbusters, cinematic universe timelines, and behind-the-scenes.
- [TV Shows Universe](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/category/tvshows): Episodic recaps, season premieres, and critical breakdowns.
- [K-Pop Universe](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/category/kpop): Comeback stages, idol profiles, MV debuts, and fandom charts.
- [Comics Universe](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/category/comics): Marvel, DC, and indie graphic novel reading guides and lore.
- [Manga Universe](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/category/manga): Top serialized manga chapters, mangaka spotlights, and tankobon releases.
- [About FandomVerse](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/about): Mission, technology stack, and lore of the Fandom universe.
- [Contact Support](https://fandom-verse-techwiz.vercel.app/#/contact): Community inquiries, partnership requests, and feedback.
